meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询并交叉分析多个生物数据库

copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Python 的 bioservices 包调用约 40 个生物信息学在线服务,在同一套接口下查询 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等数据库,产出蛋白质序列、通路、化合物信息并做数据库间 ID 转换。
howto.when: 当你要在一个流程里跨多个生物数据库查询、做数据库之间的 ID 映射,或运行 BLAST 比对时触发;原文说明单个数据库速查用 gget,序列或文件处理用 biopython。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses the Python bioservices package to reach ~40 bioinformatics web services, querying UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL and more through one API to fetch protein sequences, pathways, compounds and convert identifiers.
howto.when_en: Use when querying several biological databases in one workflow, mapping IDs across databases, or running BLAST. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file work use biopython.
